methodology.hypothesis_verdict: The run verdict says whether the pre-registered hypothesis survived.
methodology.mechanism_attribution: A school gets strong credit for predicting failure only when the test discriminates the school's mechanism, channel, sign, heterogeneity, or timing.
methodology.school_forecast: The school forecast is scored from verdict + school_prediction + polarity.
methodology.second_order_gate: Policy-experiment links are held when required second-order layers are unmeasured or undocumented.
